notes.title: Patch v1.01
notes.notes:
Lights! Camera! The first AD BLOCKER patch is now live! This update addresses two issues that were raised during the first month of release.

[list]
[*] Added option to toggle between fullscreen and windowed display modes. This is located in video settings.
[*] Patched bug where some input methods were not recognized by the title screen's "Press any button to start!" prompt. Any keyboard or controller button input should now be accepted.
[*] Watered Enrique.
[/list]

notes.title: Mac Update!
notes.notes:
That's right -- AD BLOCKER is now available to players running macOS 10.15 Catalina or newer! I've heard back from the testers, and the change should be good to go! 

Apparently Steam defaults uploads to 32-bit only and requires manual confirmation that a build is 64-bit compatible. I wasn't aware of that, so I apologize. 

Please enjoy AD BLOCKER! :)
